summary:
THE HOLE IS REAL, THE ROWS ARE ANCHORABLE, AND THE FORK IN THE ASK RESOLVES THE OTHER WAY. Three new/confirmed anchors: ep 48 -> END 110 [START 106], ep 50 -> END 113 [START 110], ep 58 -> END 118 [START 116] (CONFIRMED, and NOT short). All three rows stay CANON (confirmed as stored). No episode in the ask is filler.

THE CLAIM IN THE ASK, TESTED. AFG's row 50 does print '110-113' — but AFG row-for-row IS beelzebub.fandom's episode infobox copied (rows 44-60 read '91-96 / 95-98 / 97,98,99,100,101,115 / 102,103,104,105,115 / 106,107,108,109,110 / SPECIAL / 110-113 / 114,115 / N/A x6 / 116,117,118,123 / 119,120,121 / N/A' — identical to the wiki's fields, including the lone out-of-order 115s and the lone 123). AFG and the fandom are ONE lineage here and are never counted as two. The independent instruments are (1) Bandai Channel's per-episode licensor synopses (b-ch.com/titles/3113/048, /050, /058 — the text is in the served HTML), (2) the CHAPTER pages' reverse `episode` index plus the two arc pages' PAGE-LEVEL citations ('Chapter 109, pages 1-11' / 'pages 12-19', 'Chapter 118, pages 1-15' / 'pages 16-19'), (3) ja-Wikipedia's 各話リスト under its declared legend (bold subtitle = anime-original) plus its prose 'ストーリー全体としては第50話までは概ね原作を意識したものとなっていたが、第51話 - 第57話および第60話（最終話）はアニメオリジナル回である', (4) en-Wikipedia's per-episode ShortSummary for eps 48 and 50, (5) a contemporaneous per-episode Japanese review blog written by a Jump reader (読書とジャンプ, posts dated 2011-12-25, 2012-01-15, 2012-03-11), and (6) MangaUpdates' coverage segment, which reads 'Vol 14, Chap 121' for this entry.

BUT THE 'JUMPED-BACK BLOCK' PREMISE IS FALSE, AND THAT IS THE STRUCTURAL FINDING. Eps 48 and 50 are NOT behind eps 46/47 in content: ep 47 adapts chs 102-105 and ep 48 opens on ch 106, page 1 — the running order is continuous 102 -> 103 -> 104 -> 105 -> 106. What sits 'ahead' in eps 46/47 is a GRAFT of ch 115's opening pages (the Koma-chan/Kunieda material the anime moved forward so that Kunieda could fight in ep 48's battle at all), and the stored END 115 on BOTH eps 46 and 47 is that graft promoted to a position. Ep 47's stored row is self-contradictory on its face: END 115 [START 115] with chapters_adapted {102-105, 115} — a START that is not the row's first chapter (A13) and an END that marks chs 106-114 as read when they are not. THE HOLE THE CENSUS SAW IS THAT OVERSHOOT, not a reorder in 48/50. Eps 46/47 are outside this ask and their anchors are AFG-tier, so this is delivered as a flag with the evidence, never as a silent repair.

EP 48 (canon, confirmed) -> END 110 [START 106] {106, 107, 108, 109, 110 (part)}. The fandom's ch 106, 107, 108, 109 pages each carry `episode = [[I'm His Parent|48]]` and NO other episode; ch 110 carries `episode = 48, 50`. The content match is exact and independent: Bandai's ep-48 text ends '男鹿がこの戦いを自分とベル坊に預けるようみんなに告げる。男鹿の秘策、修行の成果による新必殺技。親子パワー炸裂…！' = ch 106 (Oga asks Hilda to stand aside; the Zebul Emblem learned from Saotome) and ch 108 (Super Milk Time, the milk, the wings). en-WP's ShortSummary walks the same chapters in order and closes on ch 109 p11 ('at last he defeated the three Pillar Heads, and with the top of Himekawa's hotel destroyed due to the explosion'). The review blog quotes ch 107's payload line verbatim in spirit — 「ベル坊は人間を滅ぼしたりしねーよ　なんで分かるかって　俺が親だからだ」 — and adds that he first saw it in Jump. ja-WP leaves バブ48 UNBOLD. END 110 by A4 + the Dai wave-13 convention: the fandom is the only chapter-enumerating source and it credits ch 110 to this row; no source contradicts it (en-WP's summary simply stops — silence is not a finding), and no page count or teaser wording exists to trigger A47's ≤5-page exception, so the END advances and the straddle is named as a `partial`. Confidence medium on the END for exactly that reason, high on the START (ep 47 ends on ch 105 and the fandom gives ch 106 to no other row).

EP 50 (canon, confirmed) -> END 113 [START 110] {110 (the close), 111, 112, 113}. The fandom's ch 111, 112, 113 pages each carry `episode = 50` and nothing else; ch 110 is shared with ep 48. ch 113 「女の戦い」 ends with Hilda and Kunieda's duel, Kunieda's demonic aura, the three of them beating Beel down and the bodies snapping back — which is where the episode stops: en-WP's summary closes 'just before they hit him Oga and BabyBeel return to normal... Saotome-sensei then comes to school the day after', and Bandai's text asks '男鹿とベル坊は無事元の姿に戻ることができるのか'. The START is the tail of ch 110 (the body-swap discovery at Oga's house: Lamia calls Hilda, Furuichi and Alaindelon upstairs and they find Oga's mind in Baby Beel's body) — the only page-level ambiguity in this verdict, recorded as `partial` and stated as unverified: no source says whether that scene closed ep 48 or opened ep 50. It is a DISPLAY question only — ep 48's continue is 110 under either reading and ep 50's continue is 114 under either reading.

EP 58 (canon, confirmed) -> END 118 [START 116] {116, 117, 118, 123 (a forward graft)}. THE END IS NOT SHORT AND 123 MUST NOT MOVE IT. Running order: ch 116 石矢魔高校復活 (the rebuilt Ishiyama, Hilda scolding Oga, the mysterious old man who beats Gō and Shinjō), ch 117 挨拶 (Kanzaki marching everyone back, Himekawa's helicopter, Saotome/Ittōsai/Isurugi vs the old man = Behemoth, the plaque swapped for 悪魔野学園), ch 118 侵入!悪魔野学園 (the break-in, the three Pillar Generals, Agiel lunging at Nene — and pp 16-19, Aoi arriving with Koma). The blog's account is that list in that order and ends '葵ちゃんとアギエルのガチンコで以下次週'; Bandai and thetv.jp print the same span. Chs 119-121 are ep 59's on the same reverse index, and ch 122 is adapted nowhere. So an END of 123 would mark 119-122 read when three of them are not — the END stays 118 (A4: furthest chapter adapted IN RUNNING ORDER), and MangaUpdates independently pins this entry's coverage at 'Vol 14, Chap 121', never 123. The 123 IS real, though, and it is delivered as a `graft`: the episode's cast list carries Takahashi, Kne, Labed, Basilisk, Salamander, Yata, Ananta and Quetzalcoatl, a roster that appears in NO chapter between 116 and 121 and is exactly ch 123 「悪魔野HR」's cast — the Akumano Academy homeroom, pulled forward to show the school the episode is named after. Weight: SLIVER (see the annotation); ch 123 is adapted properly by no episode, since the anime stops at ep 60.

TYPES. All three rows CONFIRMED AS STORED (canon), and the two live T28 questions are recorded rather than guessed. Ep 48 opens with an anime-original act the manga does not have — the Ishiyama crowd (Kunieda already carrying Koma, Tōjō, Kanzaki, Himekawa) fighting the Pillar Generals and being pushed back — where chs 105-110 give the fight to Hilda and then Oga alone; ep 50 opens with an original musical staging of the プリンプリン体操 that is a one-panel gag inside ch 113. Both are recorded as `divergence`. Neither flips the row: the episode's JOB in each case is the source's (48: Oga's return, the Zebul Emblem, Super Milk Time, 「俺が親だからだ」; 50: the swap, the hunt for Saotome, the Hilda/Kunieda duel, the restoration), the original material is an expansion of the same scene rather than a plot of its own, ja-WP leaves both subtitles UNBOLD while footnoting ep 51 explicitly as half-original, and no sizing instrument exists on this old-format AFG page. The ep-48 call is the closer of the two and is flagged.

anchors.chapters_adapted: 106, 107, 108, 109, 110 (part — the chapter straddles the ep 48 / ep 50 boundary)
anchors.why: NEW ANCHOR on a row that had none (the A18 hole). START 106 (A10, high confidence): ep 47's stored chapters are {102-105, 115} and beelzebub.fandom's ch 106 「男鹿の戦い」 page carries `episode = [[I'm His Parent|48]]` and no other episode, so ch 106 is first-time here and the episode opens on it; there is no leading partial of ch 105 on any source. END 110 (A4). The fandom's reverse index gives chs 106, 107, 108 and 109 to ep 48 ALONE and ch 110 to eps 48 and 50, i.e. ch 110 straddles the boundary. Two independent readings corroborate the block itself beat for beat: Bandai Channel's licensor synopsis ('体勢を整えたベヘモット34柱師団が再び人間界に襲来… すると突然、男鹿がこの戦いを自分とベル坊に預けるようみんなに告げる。男鹿の秘策、修行の成果による新必殺技。親子パワー炸裂…！') is ch 106's 'let me and Beel handle them' + the Zebul Emblem + ch 108's Super Milk Time and the Lord-of-the-Flies merge; en-Wikipedia's ShortSummary walks 106 -> 107 -> 108 -> 109 in order and ends on ch 109 page 11 ('at last he defeated the three Pillar Heads, and with the top of Himekawa's hotel destroyed due to the explosion' — the arc page cites that explosion as 'Chapter 109, pages 1-11'); and the review blog quotes ch 107's payload, 「ベル坊は人間を滅ぼしたりしねーよ… 俺が親だからだ」, noting he first read it in Jump. WHY THE END ADVANCES TO 110 RATHER THAN HOLDING AT 109. A47's ≤5-page / teaser-wording exception has no evidence behind it here — no source gives a page count or teaser wording for ep 48's share of ch 110 — and the Dai wave-13 ruling (Sean, 2026-09-02) is explicit that an unquantified trailing share advances the END with a `partial` naming it. The R3-before-A47 existence clause does not bite either: only ONE source enumerates chapters for this row at all (the fandom; AFG is its copy), and no source enumerates a shorter list. en-WP's summary stopping at ch 109 is SILENCE, not a counter-claim — it also omits the anime-original opening act that two other sources attest, so its endpoint is not a coverage statement. Confidence is medium precisely because the page split inside ch 110 is unverified; the continue (110) is unaffected by which reading is right. WEIGHT: SIGNIFICANT for chs 106-109 (they ARE the episode — the return, the Zebul Emblem, Super Milk Time, the defeat of Hecadoth/Graphel/Nāga, 'I'm his parent'), and the material is NEW, not a duplicate: no earlier episode animates any of it. Volume 13 agrees with the stored boundary table (v13 = 107-115); the fandom's own volume fields agree with our table chapter for chapter (ch 106 -> vol 12, ch 107-115 -> vol 13, ch 116+ -> vol 14), so no chapter-space conversion applies. NOT A BACK-JUMP: ep 48 continues the running order from ep 47's ch 105. The apparent regression against ep 47's stored END 115 is caused by the ch-115 GRAFT in eps 46/47, not by anything in this row — see the `rearranged` annotation and the flag.

anchors.chapters_adapted: 110 (the close — the body-swap discovery at Oga's house), 111, 112, 113
anchors.why: NEW ANCHOR on a row that had none (the A18 hole). END 113 (A4, high confidence): the fandom's ch 111 「入れ替わっちゃいました」, ch 112 「男鹿らしくしなさい」 and ch 113 「女の戦い」 pages each carry `episode = [[Today I'm Different on the Inside|50]]` and no other episode, and ch 113 is adapted to its last page — the chapter ends with Kunieda's kids-show dance, the Hilda/Kunieda duel with guardrail pillars, Kunieda's demonic aura, the three of them beating Beel down, the bodies snapping back and Oga confronting Saotome with Beel naked on him. That is exactly where the episode stops: en-Wikipedia's ShortSummary closes '...just before they hit him Oga and BabyBeel return to normal, leaving Oga being severely hurt by the two and BabyBeel perfectly fine. Saotome-sensei then comes to school the day after', and Bandai Channel's licensor text frames the whole episode as '男鹿とベル坊の中身が入れ替わった!? 早乙女がくるまでこの状況がバレずに切り抜けられるか？ そして男鹿とベル坊は無事元の姿に戻ることができるのか'. The review blog confirms the interior chapter by chapter: Beel-in-Oga's-body carried by Hilda and Kanzaki's 'three times stronger' gag (ch 111-112), Hilda's いないいないばぁ and the dance duel with a blushing Kunieda (ch 113). START 110 (A10), medium confidence and the one page-level gap in this verdict. The fandom credits ch 110 to eps 48 AND 50; ch 110's closing scene is the body-swap discovery (arc page: 'Hilda, Furuichi and Alaindelon climb the stairs where... they discover that Oga's subconscious has been placed in Baby Beel's body' <ref>Chapter 110</ref>), and ch 111 opens with 'Oga quickly realizes the situation'. No source states whether that discovery closed ep 48 or opened ep 50, and the anime added an original cold open (the プリンプリン体操 number) in front of it. Under A10 an unqualified leading share of the preceding chapter IS the START (the ≤5-page / recap-wording exception has no evidence behind it), so 110 is delivered — but if the discovery in fact aired at the end of ep 48 and ep 50 merely re-shows it, the true START is 111. This is a DISPLAY-only difference: ep 48's continue is 110 and ep 50's continue is 114 under either reading. Recorded as `partial` and named in the flags rather than guessed away. WEIGHT: SIGNIFICANT — chs 111-113 are the episode's whole plot and are first-time material adapted in this episode and no other. Volume 13 agrees with the stored boundary table (v13 = 107-115).

anchors.chapters_adapted: 116, 117, 118, 123 (a forward graft — the Akumano Academy homeroom roster scene; chs 119-122 are NOT adapted here, so the END stays 118)
anchors.why: END 118 CONFIRMED AS STORED, and the row gains the START it lacked. START 116 (A10): eps 52-57 are filler on every source, ep 51 ends on ch 115, and beelzebub.fandom's ch 116 「石矢魔高校復活」 page carries `episode = [[Akumano Academy Has Opened|58]]`. The blog's first beat is Hilda's exposition line to Oga about being targeted by Behemoth's 34 Pillar Division = ch 116's Oga's-house scene (the anime cuts ch 116's opening cliff-training pages with Lamia and Alaindelon — neither appears in the episode's cast list; see the `divergence`). END 118, complete. The running order is ch 116 (the rebuilt Ishiyama; the mysterious old man beating Gō and Shinjō while hunting Oga) -> ch 117 (Kanzaki leading everyone back, the thanks to Sadohara, Himekawa's helicopter, Saotome + Ittōsai + Isurugi against the old man, revealed as Behemoth, and the plaque replaced with 悪魔野学園) -> ch 118 (the break-in, the En statues, Agiel/Odonel/Zela, Nene's chains, Agiel drawing her sword — and pp 16-19, Aoi arriving with Koma). Three independent readings agree: Bandai Channel ('石矢魔高校の新校舎がついに完成！ だが、学校がもともとあった場所に建っていたのは「悪魔野学園」なる別の学校!? … 石矢魔高校VS悪魔野学園の因縁の対決再び！ その頃、謎の老人が男鹿の行方を探していた…。'), thetv.jp's listing text (the same three beats), and the review blog, which walks Kanzaki on the teacher's desk, the greeting to Sadohara, Himekawa's helicopter, Behemoth's outfit and 'meanwhile at Akumano Academy' Agiel, and ends '葵ちゃんとアギエルのガチンコで以下次週' — the exact page-level close the arc page cites as 'Chapter 118, pages 16-19'. ch 119 「激突!! VSアギエル!!」, 120 and 121 all carry `episode = 59`. WHY THE END IS NOT 123 (the ask's 'is it short?'). ch 123 IS in this episode (see the `graft` annotation), but it is a FORWARD jump over chs 119-122, three of which are unadapted at this point (119-121 are ep 59's; 122 is adapted by no episode). A4 defines the END as the furthest mainline chapter adapted IN RUNNING ORDER, and an END of 123 would tell a reader they had read 119-122 when they have not. Independent corroboration that 123 is not coverage: MangaUpdates' segment for this entry reads 'Vol 14, Chap 121' — the anime's coverage endpoint, never 123. So the END stays 118 and the ch-123 pages are annotated, not positioned (A44: a fragment is position-less). WEIGHT: SIGNIFICANT for chs 116-118 — they are the episode's plot end to end, first-time, adapted here and nowhere else. Volume 14 agrees with the stored boundary table (v14 = 116-124) and with the fandom's own volume field on chs 116-118.

continue_points.why: C2 parity, which here coincides with C1. Ep 48 ends inside ch 110 (the chapter is shared with ep 50 on the fandom's reverse index), so C1 alone would already continue IN 110; and the next canon row that adapts source pages, ep 50, STARTS on ch 110, so parity lands on the same number. Ep 49 in between adapts the unnumbered vol-10 extra plus a licensed novel (Sean's rulings of 2026-09-03 / 2026-09-05) and moves no mainline position. No unseen range to name between this row and the next: chs 106-110 are adapted here in order and ch 110 is finished by ep 50. C3 note for the reader arriving at 110: the chapter's opening (En's declaration accepted, the demons' departure) has already been shown; the discovery of the body swap on its closing pages may also have been — the split is unverified — so read ch 110 through and expect a familiar first half. Medium confidence tracks that same unverified split; the value 110 is correct under BOTH readings of it.

C2 parity, which here coincides with END + 1. Ep 50 finishes ch 113 on its last page (the bodies snap back and Oga confronts Saotome — en-WP: 'Saotome-sensei then comes to school the day after'), so nothing is left mid-chapter and C1 does not apply. The next canon row is ep 51 (mixed, ruled 2026-09-05) whose START is 114 — beelzebub.fandom's ch 114 「烈怒帝瑠大作戦」 page carries `episode = 51` and no other episode. C3 SKIP NOTE for the reader arriving at 114: ch 115's OPENING pages have already been animated out of order in eps 46/47 (the fandom's ch 115 page lists eps 46, 47 and 51), and ep 51 returns for the Koma-chan origin flashback and the chapter's close — so chs 114-115 should still be read in full from page 1, with part of 115's opening already familiar.

C2 parity, which here coincides with END + 1. Ep 58 finishes ch 118 on its last page (Aoi arrives with Koma; the arc page cites 'Chapter 118, pages 16-19' for exactly that beat, and the blog records the episode ending on the Aoi-vs-Agiel standoff 'with 以下次週'), so C1 does not apply. The next canon row, ep 59, STARTS on ch 119 — the fandom's ch 119, 120 and 121 pages each carry `episode = [[We're the Strongest|59]]`. C3 SKIP NOTE for the reader arriving at 119: ch 123 「悪魔野HR」's Akumano homeroom roster scene has ALREADY been shown, grafted forward into ep 58 — read chs 119-122 normally and expect ch 123's classroom to be partly familiar. Chs 122 and 124 onwards are adapted by no episode at all (the anime ends at ep 60 with an original finale), and ep 59's own coverage stops inside ch 121.

annotations.note: A42 / A18 — WHAT THE REORDER ACTUALLY IS, recorded because the display will otherwise read this row as a back-jump. Ep 48 is NOT behind its neighbours in content: ep 47 adapts chs 102-105 and this episode opens on ch 106 page 1, so the running order is continuous. The regression against ep 47's STORED END of 115 comes from the other side — eps 46 and 47 each carry a GRAFT of ch 115's opening pages (the fandom's ch 115 page lists `episode = 46, 47, 51`; AFG prints a lone '115' at the end of both otherwise contiguous rows), and that graft was promoted into an END. The anime moved ch 115's Koma-chan material forward for a reason this episode makes visible: Kunieda is already carrying Koma when the Pillar Generals attack here, which in the manga cannot happen (she is away training until ch 111). So: chs 106-110 are first-time, in order, and NOT a back-jump; the position that reaches ahead of them is eps 46/47's ch-115 graft. Weight of the reorder for this row: it changes no chapter's standing — every page ep 48 adapts is new.

annotations.chapters: 110 (the chapter straddles the ep 48 / ep 50 boundary; the page split is unverified)
annotations.note: weight: SIGNIFICANT and the material is NEW — but the SPLIT is unverified and that is stated rather than guessed. beelzebub.fandom credits ch 110 「とりあえず一件落着!?」 (19 pp) to BOTH ep 48 and ep 50, so the chapter is shared. Its three movements are, from the arc page's page-level walk: (a) Himekawa and Kanzaki kicking the unconscious Graphel and accepting En's declared war, Hilda handing the wounded Pillars back, En promising to return with an army; (b) that night — the Red Tail walking home, Himekawa atop his ruined apartment, Shiroyama finally waking; (c) at Oga's house, Lamia calling Hilda, Furuichi and Alaindelon upstairs, where they find Oga's mind in Baby Beel's body. NO SOURCE STATES WHERE THE CUT FALLS. en-Wikipedia's ep-48 summary stops earlier still (at ch 109 p11's explosion) but is demonstrably incomplete — it omits the anime-original opening act two other sources attest — so its endpoint is silence, not a boundary. The blog's 「姫川先輩のビルぶっ壊れて」 fits (a)/(b) but also fits ch 109's explosion. Ep 50's own Bandai text opens with the swap already in force. The honest record: ch 110 is in both rows, ep 48 has at least its opening and ep 50 has at least its close, and the reader's position is unaffected — ep 48's continue is 110 either way.

weight: recorded so the CANON typing is auditable — an original expansion that does not carry the episode's plot (T28's faithfulness clause), NOT an original half. The manga gives the Pillar Generals' assault to Hilda and then to Oga alone (arc page, chs 105-110: Hilda entangles Hecadoth, Alaindelon is swung as a club, Oga asks Hilda to stand aside). The anime instead opens ep 48 with the whole Ishiyama side fighting them first: Bandai Channel's licensor text gives it three of five sentences ('ついに石矢魔高校の面々と激突する。思いのほか好勝負を繰り広げるものの、本気を出し始めた悪魔たちを相手に追い詰められてゆく。すると突然、男鹿がこの戦いを自分とベル坊に預けるようみんなに告げる'), and the contemporaneous review blog lists the participants — Kanzaki landing a heel kick on a demon, Kunieda already using Koma's power, Hilda and Kunieda back to back, Tōjō's eyes glowing red — none of which exists in chs 105-110, where Kunieda and Tōjō are absent entirely. The anime bought this by grafting ch 115's Koma material forward into eps 46/47. WHY THE ROW STAYS CANON. The episode's job is the source's: Oga's return with the Zebul Emblem (ch 106), Saotome's warning and 「オレが…」 (ch 107), Super Milk Time and the Lord-of-the-Flies merge (ch 108), the three Pillar Generals destroyed (ch 109), En's retreat (ch 110) — and the title beat, 「ベル坊は人間を滅ぼしたりしねーよ… 俺が親だからだ」, is ch 107's. The original material is a restaged prologue to an adapted scene, not a plot of its own. ja-Wikipedia leaves バブ48's subtitle UNBOLD under its declared legend (アニメ版オリジナルストーリーのサブタイトルは太字) while footnoting バブ51 as half-original — a discriminating negative on this very row; its prose adds '第50話までは概ね原作を意識したもの'. en-WP's summary is pure manga. NO SIZING INSTRUMENT EXISTS (this AFG page is the old format with no minute ranges), so the share is not measured; the call is flagged for Sean as the closer of this verdict's two T28 questions.

annotations.chapters: 110 (the close — the body-swap discovery; the chapter's earlier pages are ep 48's)
annotations.note: weight: SIGNIFICANT if it is here at all, and the material would be NEW — but the split is UNVERIFIED, the same fact recorded from the other side. beelzebub.fandom credits ch 110 to ep 50 as well as ep 48. Ch 110's closing pages are the discovery scene (arc page: 'Lamia comes from Oga's room saying that Baby Beel has awakened... Hilda, Furuichi and Alaindelon climb the stairs where... they discover that Oga's subconscious has been placed in Baby Beel's body' <ref>Chapter 110</ref>), and ch 111 begins from 'Oga quickly realizes the situation'. Ep 50's own openers on two sources are the swap ALREADY in force (Bandai: '男鹿とベル坊に問題発生！ 男鹿とベル坊の中身が入れ替わった!?'; en-WP: 'Due to the after effects of Super Milk Time, Baby Beel and Oga have swapped bodies'), which is consistent both with the discovery opening this episode and with it having closed ep 48 and being re-shown here. If the latter, the share is a `recap` and the START is 111. Named, not guessed; the reader's continue is 114 either way.

weight: recorded so the CANON typing is auditable — an original staging of a source gag, not a story-carrying original share. The episode opens with a full anime-original musical number: the contemporaneous review blog's first reaction is 'え？チャンネル間違えた？的なプリンプリン体操から始まりました。こうして曲がつくのってアニメならではですよね' — an exercise-show segment with a leotarded 体操のお姉さん. In the source this is one gag inside ch 113: Kunieda 'performs a dance she learned from a kids show that she practices for Kōta', which she then uses against Hilda in the duel. The anime front-loads the show itself so the duel's gag lands. WHY THE ROW STAYS CANON: the episode's plot is chs 110-113 end to end (the discovery, the walk to Saint Ishiyama, the Nan High delinquents, the search for Saotome, Kanzaki's chain, Beel bolting toward Kunieda, the Hilda/Kunieda duel, the restoration), and the added number serves an adapted scene. ja-WP leaves バブ50's subtitle UNBOLD and its prose says the story followed the manga through ep 50.

weight: SLIVER — because it is a roster scene pulled forward out of order that does not carry this episode's plot, and it is FIRST-TIME material, not a duplicate. ch 123 「悪魔野HR」 (19 pp) is the Akumano Academy homeroom: Takahashi in front of a class of Pillar Generals — Kne, Labed, Basilisk, Salamander, Yata, Vritra, Ananta, Lindworm, Agiel, Odonel, Quetzalcoatl — with En, Jabberwock and Behemoth. Ep 58's own cast list carries Takahashi, Kne, Labed, Basilisk, Salamander, Yata, Ananta and Quetzalcoatl, and NONE of those characters appears in chs 116, 117, 118, 119, 120 or 121; the fandom's ch 123 page returns the tie in the other direction with `episode = [[Akumano Academy Has Opened|58]]`. The episode is named for the school opening, and this is the scene that shows it. NO EPISODE ADAPTS CH 123 PROPERLY — the anime stops at ep 60 (an original finale) and ch 122 and chs 124+ are never adapted at all — so the note cannot name a later home for these pages; that is the honest state, not an omission. IT DOES NOT MOVE THE END: chs 119-122 sit between this graft and the episode's running-order END of 118, and 119-121 are ep 59's while 122 is adapted nowhere, so positioning ep 58 at 123 would mark four chapters read that are not (A4; A44 — a fragment is position-less). MangaUpdates independently ends this entry's coverage at 'Vol 14, Chap 121'. structure.notes: NO STRUCTURAL CHANGE PROPOSED, but the wave's hole has a structural CAUSE and it is not in the rows I was given. (1) THE HOLE'S ORIGIN. Eps 48 and 50 are not a jumped-back block: ep 47 adapts chs 102-105, ep 48 opens on ch 106 page 1, ep 50 ends on ch 113's last page and ep 51 starts on ch 114 — chs 102 -> 115 run forward without a single regression. What reaches ahead is the ch-115 GRAFT the anime placed in eps 46 and 47 (the fandom's ch 115 page lists `episode = 46, 47, 51`; AFG prints a lone '115' at the end of both rows' otherwise contiguous lists), and the stored anchors turned that graft into an END of 115 on BOTH rows. Ep 47's stored row is self-contradictory as a result — END 115 [START 115] with chapters_adapted {102-105, 115}: the START is not the row's first chapter (A13) and the END marks chs 106-114 as read. Fix the 46/47 ENDs and the 'hole' at 48/50 disappears; leave them and the display will read this verdict's anchors as a back-jump. Eps 46/47 are outside this ask and their anchors are AFG-tier, so this is a flag with evidence, never a silent repair. (2) WHY THE ANIME GRAFTED CH 115 EARLY, which is the substantive finding behind (1): it needed Kunieda to already have Koma so she could fight in ep 48's expanded battle. The graft is a production decision, not a wiki artefact. (3) AFG IS NOT A SECOND SOURCE ON THIS SERIES — confirmed row by row this wave.
